errors.text_span: erscheint der Balken für die „OECD“ in einem hellen Violett und der Balken für die „EU27“ in einem dunkleren Violett
errors.evidence: The description claims that the bars for OECD and EU27 are different shades of violet ('light violet' and 'darker violet'). However, in the chart, both bars have the same purple/mauve color, used to distinguish them from the blue bars.
This is a continuation of the previous error. The bar for EU27 is not 'dark violet'; it is the same color as the OECD bar.
